scripts.dev: npm run config:render && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/render-wrangler.mjs --output wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run config:render && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/render-wrangler.mjs --output wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
